discovery: Discovery of geometric phases in quantum mechanics (the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the Berry phase)
rationale: Recent prizes went to quantum circuits (2025), machine learning (2024), attosecond physics (2023) and entanglement (2022). That makes a foundational theoretical result in quantum physics a plausible next pick. Geometric and topological phases underpin modern topological matter, quantum computing and precision measurement. Both laureates have long been perennial favorites, and their advanced ages make recognition timely.
